findings: Captured 43 additional date-specific movement classes: 30 individually published ADC sessions across five selected weekly calendars and 13 date-selected EQUAL Linnaeusstraat classes from the public Oct 20–Nov 1 horizon. No recurring dates were inferred.
ADC sessions are exact one-off calendar rows labelled beginner, basic, open level or all levels; intermediate and advanced classes were excluded. Adult single-class price €22.50 without membership.
EQUAL sessions include a published bookable class row and beginner suitability from the class description or official FAQ; single class is €20. Heated classes need a towel; €2.50 rental.
All rows are new relative to canonical events.json at capture time; no event was booked and remaining capacity was not checked.
gaps: ADC public date picker exposed full individually published schedules for Oct 26–Nov 29, but no ADC session was added for Nov 30 in this batch.
EQUAL public date selector was observed through Nov 1 only; no later EQUAL date was inferred.
Teaching language and remaining capacity were not shown on the selected class listings.
